Tracy's broker since 1988

The agent who answers his own phone.

Jack Klemm has been selling homes in Tracy since 1988 — nearly four thousand of them. He's not a team with his name on it. When you call, you get Jack: the same person who prices your home, runs the contractors, and negotiates your contract.

Klemm Real Estate is his own independent brokerage, which means no franchise playbook and no handing you off. Just a broker who's watched this market for thirty-eight years and knows what your street sells for.
